title: Qinux release channel
description: Defines an update stream. Every file in channels/ validates against this schema.

$comment.description: Note for humans and generators. Validators ignore it.

name.description: Channel identifier. Must match the filename.

description.description: One sentence explaining who this channel is for.

policy.description: When this channel accepts new builds.

frequency.description: on-release moves only at a release; continuous moves as builds land.

guarantees.description: Promises this channel keeps, such as installability.

current.description: Version users on this channel should be on. null means not yet published.

components.description: Components included in this channel. Omitted means all.
